purpose: Retention inventory plus verified archival of small runtime metadata. Checkpoint deletion candidates are marked for manual cleanup; no deletion was performed.

method.sizes: Sum of regular-file logical st_size values; directory entries excluded. Sources, runs and reports are inventoried with mutually exclusive file selections.
method.hashing: SHA-256 only of the 32 small archived metadata JSON files. No model weights/runtime payloads were hashed or loaded.
method.deduplication: Not performed. Same-sized files are not asserted to be byte-identical.
method.space_estimates: Logical sizes are not guaranteed reclaimed physical space; APFS shared/cloned extents may overlap.
method.scope: checkpoints/minicpm5_source, runs, and reports. This new inventory file is excluded from the snapshot totals to avoid self-reference. Other workspace files are outside this storage inventory.
method.candidate_semantics: Candidate status is a proposal only. Archives preserve receipts/provenance, not weights/optimizer/RNG payloads; deletion removes the corresponding resume capability. No deletion is performed or implied by this inventory.
